channel.title: Vision Field Notes
channel.description: Practical computer vision and edge AI, from someone who runs it in production.

item.title: mAP, Precision and Recall: How to Read Detection Results
item.description: Learn how to read precision, recall, mAP50 and mAP50-95 in object detection results, and which metric matters most for your own use case and camera setup.

item.title: Zone Intrusion and Dwell Time Alerts
item.description: How to build zone intrusion and dwell time alerts: define polygon zones, test points with point-in-polygon, run dwell timers, and handle the edge cases.

item.title: YOLOv5 vs YOLOv8 vs YOLO11: Which Should You Use?
item.description: YOLOv5 vs YOLOv8 vs YOLO11 compared in practice: workflow, accuracy and speed trade-offs, export support and licence, plus a simple way to decide.

item.title: YOLO Licenses Explained: AGPL, GPL and Commercial Use
item.description: YOLO licenses explained: what AGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 mean for YOLO projects, options for commercial products and safe habits. Not legal advice.

item.title: What Is YOLO? Object Detection Explained Without the Math
item.description: What is YOLO? A plain explanation of how this object detection model finds objects in a single pass, what its output means, and where it fits in a project.

item.title: Training on Google Colab: Limits and Workarounds
item.description: Train a YOLO model on Google Colab: what the free tier is good for, session limits, saving checkpoints to Drive, resuming runs and when to move on.

item.title: Train/Validation Split for Video Frames: Avoid Data Leakage
item.description: Why a random train/validation split of video frames inflates metrics, and how to split by video, camera and time so your detection results can be trusted.

item.title: Train YOLO on a Custom Dataset: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Train YOLO on a custom dataset with Ultralytics: folder layout, data.yaml, the training command, reading results and the first improvements to try.

item.title: TensorRT for YOLO: When and How to Use It
item.description: TensorRT for YOLO explained: what it optimises, how to build an engine, FP16 and INT8 modes, portability limits and a safe workflow for NVIDIA GPUs.

item.title: Setting Up a Clean Python Environment for Computer Vision
item.description: Set up a clean Python environment for computer vision: venv, pinned requirements, matching PyTorch to CUDA, and reproducible installs for training and edge.

item.title: Scaling Video Analytics to Hundreds of Camera Streams
item.description: Architecture patterns for scaling video analytics to hundreds of camera streams: decoding, batching, frame skipping, queues, GPU sharing and monitoring.

item.title: Running YOLO on a Raspberry Pi 5: What to Expect
item.description: Running YOLO on a Raspberry Pi 5: setup, model choices, export formats, thread tuning and realistic expectations, with a way to measure speed yourself.

item.title: Running Object Detection in the Browser with ONNX Runtime Web
item.description: Run object detection in the browser with ONNX Runtime Web: how WASM and WebGPU execution works, model size limits, pre-processing and privacy benefits.

item.title: Reducing False Alarms in Production Video Analytics
item.description: Cut false alarms in production video analytics with post-processing, temporal filtering, masks, per-camera tuning and monitoring for data drift over time.

item.title: Reading RTSP Streams with OpenCV and FFmpeg
item.description: How to read an RTSP stream with OpenCV and FFmpeg: opening the URL, controlling buffering and latency, TCP vs UDP, and fixes for the most common errors.

item.title: Raspberry Pi vs Jetson Orin Nano for Object Detection
item.description: Raspberry Pi vs Jetson Orin Nano for object detection: how GPU, software stack, power, price and ecosystem should decide which board fits your project.

item.title: Raspberry Pi AI Kit and Hailo Accelerators: Is It Worth It?
item.description: Is the Raspberry Pi AI Kit with a Hailo accelerator worth it? What it changes for detection projects, the trade-offs, and when a plain CPU is enough.

item.title: Privacy and Ethics in Camera Analytics
item.description: Practical privacy and ethics for camera analytics: data minimisation, retention, signage, consent, bias and access control. General guidance, not legal advice.

item.title: Power, Cooling and Storage for a Reliable Edge AI Box
item.description: How to build a reliable edge AI box: power supply quality, thermal throttling and cooling, SD card wear versus SSD storage, and uptime practices.

item.title: People Counting with Line Crossing: A Practical Tutorial
item.description: Build a people counter with line crossing: use tracks, check which side of a line a point is on, count direction, avoid double counting and validate the result.

item.title: OpenCV Essentials Every Computer Vision Engineer Needs
item.description: The OpenCV functions you use daily: reading images and video, drawing boxes, colour spaces, resizing, transforms, and the pitfalls that cause silent bugs.

item.title: Object Tracking Explained: SORT, ByteTrack and Friends
item.description: Learn how object trackers like SORT and ByteTrack link detections across video frames, why ID switches happen, and how to tune a tracker with Ultralytics.

item.title: Nano, Small, Medium: How to Choose a YOLO Model Size
item.description: How to choose a YOLO model size and input resolution: a method that starts from your hardware budget and accuracy needs, not a guess at nano, small or medium.

item.title: Measuring FPS and Latency Correctly
item.description: Measure FPS and latency correctly for vision models: warm-up, model time vs end-to-end time, batch effects, GPU synchronisation and a simple benchmark.

item.title: IoU and Non-Maximum Suppression, Explained with Examples
item.description: Intersection over Union and non-maximum suppression explained step by step, with worked examples, code, and typical IoU and NMS threshold choices for detectors.

item.title: INT8 Quantization for Detectors: Benefits and Risks
item.description: INT8 quantization for object detectors: post-training vs quantization-aware training, calibration data, what accuracy risks to expect and how to test them.

item.title: How to Spot Overfitting in Object Detection
item.description: How to spot overfitting in object detection: read loss curves and validation metrics, recognise the warning signs, and apply practical fixes that work.

item.title: How YOLOv7 Gets Real-Time Speed with Re-parameterization
item.description: How YOLOv7 uses re-parameterization: training-time and inference-time structure, how layers merge, and what it means when you export and deploy the model.

item.title: How Many Images Do You Need to Train an Object Detector?
item.description: How many images to train an object detector? Realistic dataset sizes, how to know when to stop collecting, and ways to get more from a small dataset.

item.title: Host Computer Vision Demos for Free on GitHub Pages
item.description: Host a computer vision demo for free on GitHub Pages: static hosting, running an ONNX model in the browser, size limits, licensing and a shareable portfolio demo.
